# Prairie Fresh® Garozzo’s Sausage Highlighted on FOX4 Great Day KC


On April 1, co-branded Prairie Fresh® Garozzo’s Italian Style Pork Sausage was featured on Fox 4’s[Great Day KC](https://fox4kc.com/great-day-kc/) as Michael Garozzo, co-owner of Garozzo’s Ristorante, prepared a comforting biscuits and gravy Easter brunch segment for FOX4 viewers.


Packages Prairie Fresh® Garozzo’s Italian Style Pork Sausage.[Click here to find it in a store near you!](https://www.prairiefresh.com/where-to-buy/?_gl=1%2A89o3or%2A_up%2AMQ..%2A_ga%2AMTg1MTQ2NzI3LjE3NzU4Mjk2NzM.%2A_ga_1DJR6GDWL7%2AczE3NzU4Mjk2NzIkbzEkZzAkdDE3NzU4Mjk2NzIkajYwJGwwJGg3OTk5NjcyMDM.)


Using Prairie Fresh® Garozzo’s Italian Style Pork Sausage, Garozzo showed how a familiar brunch favorite can be elevated with bold, Italian-inspired flavor—making it an approachable and crowd-pleasing option for Easter morning.


The Great Day KC appearance reinforced Prairie Fresh® as a trusted protein choice for holiday entertaining. The segment also spotlighted the successful partnership between Seaboard Foods and Garozzo’s—bringing restaurant-quality flavor from Kansas City institutions into consumers’ homes.
